summary: Iter 68b · Queue-Status endpoint + Operator View · Full validation PASS. All 9/9 pytest backend tests + all 14 Playwright frontend assertions green. Engine confirmed alive and unpaused (Operational, 19 sends today, 157 ready, 2 hot leads). No new issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: queue-status recent_sends entries are not uniform — some older outbound_events docs lack the `ts` field (only `created_at`). Not a bug per se, but the spec promised both; either (a) backfill legacy docs with ts=created_at, or (b) drop `ts` from the promised schema and let the UI read `created_at` uniformly. Currently works because the UI only renders `kind` + `email`.

PortalOpsPage.jsx is now 4314 lines (+241 from Iter 68). Still well past the >700-line guideline. OperatorView (~235 lines) is a clean candidate for extraction into /components/OperatorView.jsx alongside SystemSignalLight — no business logic inside, purely presentational on dash + queue props.

OperatorView reads queue-status directly (30s interval) AND dashboard (longer poll). Two independent fetches on the same tab — fine for now, but if scaling adds friction, consider merging into a single /ops/outbound/status endpoint that returns both payloads.

`opsOutboundQueueStatus` errors are silently swallowed in OperatorView.refresh (catch {}). Good for UX (no red banner when engine is fine) but the operator has no way to tell the queue fetch itself is failing. Consider a tiny inline error pill on the header next to the refresh button.
